decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project, no invite, no reply to either outreach ([email:0d257b98], [email:93bbeee4]) and zero tickets - no signal of engagement. Accounts silent through the first week rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days, though it's not impossible.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Just checking in as you settle into Wrenfield. Nothing's come through from your side yet, so I wanted to make it easy: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring in the rest of Cedar Labs, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
